definitions.gloss: bending backward; leaning back; arching the body backward
definitions.explanation: The action or posture of bending the upper body backward, away from something. Can describe a physical posture, a startled recoil, or an exaggerated backward lean.

examples.japanese: のけぞり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧になった。
examples.english: I ended up leaning way back.

examples.japanese: ⟦{驚|おどろ}いて→驚く：01255_odoroku⟧のけぞり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧ほど⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{値段|ねだん}→値段：00871_nedan⟧だった。
examples.english: The price was so shocking I practically fell over backward.

examples.japanese: ⟦{赤|あか}ちゃん→赤ちゃん：01282_akachan⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{急|きゅう}→急：13042_kyuu⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧のけぞりになって、⟦{抱|だ}いていた→抱く：02131_daku⟧⟦{母親|ははおや}→母親：03564_hahaoya⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{慌|あわ}てた→慌てる：01874_awateru⟧。
examples.english: The baby suddenly arched backward, and the mother holding it panicked.

notes:
The noun form of the verb のけぞる (to bend/lean backward, to recoil). The verb form is more commonly used than the noun.

のけぞる often describes an involuntary backward movement caused by surprise, shock, or disgust. It can also describe babies arching their backs, or a physical posture in certain exercises or stretches.

COMMON PATTERNS:
- のけぞり⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦なる→なる：01970_naru⟧: to end up leaning backward
- のけぞり⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{姿勢|しせい}→姿勢：00371_shisei⟧: a backward-leaning posture

RELATED WORDS:
- のけぞる: to bend backward, to recoil — the verb form (more common)
- ⟦{仰向|あおむ}け→仰向け：05548_aomuke⟧: lying face-up — a resting position, not a recoil
- ⟦{反|そ}り{返|かえ}る→反り返る：16769_sorikaeru⟧: to arch backward — similar meaning, more deliberate
